scope: Minecraft 26.3 native timed-camera qualification plus unchanged movement and deterministic construction regressions; no LLM calls in rotation/movement.
architecture: goal -> existing Python skills -> one actor-bound native RotationController and ordinary input leases -> Minecraft tick updates -> bounded telemetry

fixture.restore_policy: Each independent cohort restores and byte-validates the same owned closed snapshot.

acceptance.instant_snap_detector: For arcs > 5 degrees, one tick may not consume >= 80% of the requested arc.
acceptance.note: Receipts never substitute for terminal native rotation state, endpoint orientation, cancellation stability or tick traces.

historical_superflat_test_B.meaning: Unchanged historical assessment; this regression does not rerun or relabel B01.

historical_native_movement_parity.meaning: Unchanged historical strict tick-parity assessment; correctness regression GO is separate.

profile_comparison.selection_reason: Both profiles meet all gates; smoothstep retains zero-slope eased endpoints while linear remains explicitly selectable.

final_client.note: Read-only closure observation after all retained live cohorts; terminal cancelled state is the explicit stop from the cancellation scenario, not an active plan. The game JVM exited through native Quit Game; only the owned stale launch wrappers were then terminated.

limitations: One owned deterministic Minecraft 26.3 fixture; this is not general renderer, server or mod-pack qualification.
Requested durations are quantized by actual client ticks; tolerance is explicit and does not promise sub-tick completion.
Combat camera behavior remains separate and was intentionally not migrated by this work.
Movement still does not qualify slabs, fluids, caves, arbitrary collision shapes or hostile unattended Survival.
Construction A19 is a fresh regression, not a replacement for the frozen A11-A13 Test-A cohort or a Test-B rerun.
A16, A17 and A18 remain failures; no debug continuation is counted as a fresh success.
No release, upload or production deployment is authorized by this evidence.
